info.title: POSE Human Layer API
info.description:
REST API for the POSE Human Layer blockchain explorer, analytics, and developer tools.

This API provides comprehensive access to:
- Block explorer (transactions, blocks, addresses, identities, proofs)
- Network analytics (TPS, finality, validator metrics)
- ZK proof analytics (generation rates, circuit modes, verification metrics)
- Identity analytics (registrations, liveness scores, human weight)
- Contract interaction (view contracts, call functions, query events)
- Slashing evidence exploration
- Real-time updates via WebSocket

All endpoints return JSON responses following a consistent format with `ok` status field.
Error responses include detailed error messages and appropriate HTTP status codes.

**Rate Limits:** Standard rate limits apply. See rate limiting documentation for details.
**Authentication:** Currently public access. API key authentication coming in future versions.

Establish a WebSocket connection for real-time updates. The server broadcasts events for new blocks, transactions, proofs, validator status changes, slashing events, and metrics updates.

**Connection:** Connect to `ws://localhost:3001/ws` (or `wss://` for production)

**Message Format:** All messages are JSON objects with the following structure:
```json
{
  "type": "block" | "transaction" | "proof" | "validator" | "slashing" | "metrics" | "ping" | "pong",
  "data": { ... },
  "timestamp": 1234567890
}
```

**Client Messages:**
- Send `{"type": "ping"}` to check connection health. Server responds with `{"type": "pong"}`

**Server Broadcasts:**
- `block`: New block mined
- `transaction`: New transaction confirmed
- `proof`: New ZK proof submitted
- `validator`: Validator status changed
- `slashing`: Slashing event detected
- `metrics`: Network metrics updated

**Connection Lifecycle:**
- Server sends ping every 30 seconds to keep connection alive
- Client should respond with pong
- Connection closes on error or timeout

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid WebSocket upgrade request

ServiceUnavailable.description: Service unavailable - metrics disabled or service down
